title: Auto Loans: returned payment fee and extension fee amounts
content:
# Auto Loans: returned payment fee and extension fee amounts

This fee card states two flat servicing fees of each Auto Loans product at PCB: the fee charged when a payment is returned unpaid, and the fee charged for each payment extension granted. Both are fixed USD amounts, not percentages.

| Auto Loans product | Returned payment fee (USD, per payment returned unpaid) | Extension fee (USD, per extension granted) |
|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 25.00 | 35.00 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 25.00 | 35.00 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 25.00 | 35.00 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 25.00 | 35.00 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 25.00 | 35.00 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 25.00 | 35.00 |

## Quick answers

**Does the returned payment fee depend on the size of the returned payment?** No. It is a flat 25.00 USD on every product.

**Is the extension fee charged per extension or per installment deferred?** Per extension granted: 35.00 USD on every product, whatever the number of installments that extension defers.

**Lookup illustration (hypothetical):** one payment returned unpaid on a Lease Buyout Loan reads a fee of 25.00; one extension granted on a Green Vehicle Loan reads a fee of 35.00.
